About these 55 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Sunday has the most, with 15. The earliest start is Marina Lite (Velo Club La Grange) at 6:30 am; the latest is VFIXII Wednesday Night Ride at 8:00 pm. After work, 14 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 15 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 12. There are 3 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 5 for women, trans and femme riders and 2 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
